findings.name: Zero ActionLedger Bypass & Full Resource Shutdown
findings.detail: All RPC methods pass through ActionLedger and stop() shuts down terminalManager & browserService.

findings.name: ActionLedgerWal Monotonic Sequence, SHA-256 Checksum & Fsync
findings.detail: WAL uses cumulative monotonic sequence across snapshots, SHA-256 checksums, and explicit fsyncSync.

findings.name: Upstream Security Gate Before WAL & ESM Compatibility
findings.detail: Security validation executes upstream of ActionLedger using ESM-safe createRequire.

findings.name: Concurrent-Safe MCP Server Pool & WeakMap Schema Cache
findings.detail: MCP handler isolates concurrent requests via mcpServerPool and caches schemas via WeakMap.

findings.name: True Concurrency Measurement Methodology
findings.detail: Concurrency benchmarks explicitly track requestedConcurrency vs actualPeakConcurrency.
